summary.intent: Update GSD capture workflows to check the current branch before committing and automatically switch to a docs/ branch if on main, after the assistant accidentally committed directly to main.
summary.outcome: The accidental commit was preserved on docs/reverify-ipns-signature-todo and removed from local main via git reset --hard. A branch-protection guard was added to four GSD workflows (add-todo, add-backlog, plant-seed, check-todos) and committed on docs/gsd-capture-branch-guard.

repo: GSD capture/todo workflows (add-todo, add-backlog, plant-seed, check-todos) all commit .planning/ changes inline to the current branch by design; the `note` workflow does not commit.
CLAUDE.md contains a branch-protection rule prohibiting direct commits to main.
The /gsd:capture workflow uses `gsd-tools query commit` which commits to HEAD without branch awareness.

code.finding: Added branch-protection guard: switches to a dated docs/planning-YYYYMMDD branch when HEAD is main or master before committing.
Added same branch-protection guard as add-todo.md.
Added same branch-protection guard as add-todo.md.
Added same branch-protection guard as add-todo.md.

workflow: When reverting an accidental commit: `git branch <new-branch> <commit-sha>` to save it, then `git reset --hard origin/main` to rewind — preserves work without force-push.
Branch-protection guards in workflow files should default to a dated docs/planning-YYYYMMDD branch to avoid naming collisions across sessions.

friction: The GSD workflow committed directly to main without any branch awareness, violating project branch-protection rules — a design gap in the workflow tooling.
The assistant did not check the current branch before invoking /gsd:capture, which led to the accidental main commit.
open_items: The commit on docs/reverify-ipns-signature-todo (b31f58dd8) containing re-verification edits has not been pushed or PR'd — left for the user to handle when convenient.
The docs/gsd-capture-branch-guard branch with the workflow guard changes has not been pushed or merged to main yet.
Consider whether the underlying gsd-tools binary should also be patched to refuse commits on protected branches, rather than relying solely on workflow-level guards.
